name: law-crossdomain-v2
notes: Cross-domain embedder constellation. Exactly one general-semantic lane; one each legal/medical/finance/scientific domain lane; learned-sparse and structural lanes. No token-level Multi/ColBERT lane (search-pin + build-RSS budget, ref #1491). All embedder lanes serve fp16 (ref TEI dtype note; int8 dynamic-quant falls back to CPU on the CUDA EP). Hard cap: total resident embedder VRAM <= 10240 MiB. Content-lens floor >= 10 (MIN_CONTENT_LENSES).

embedder_lanes.note: BAM Embeddings — genuine finance-domain retriever from Balyasny Asset Management (EMNLP 2024), contrastively trained on 14.3M finance query/passage pairs; base = multilingual-e5-base (XLM-R), so requires E5 'query:'/'passage:' prefixes. Commercial (Apache-2.0). Replaces FinLang/finance-embeddings-investopedia (CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial, MUST NOT ship). No in-house finetune needed. Lighter documented alternative: philschmid/bge-base-financial-matryoshka (Apache-2.0, 109M, 768/512/256 Matryoshka, NDCG@10 0.82 on synthetic 10-K eval). AVOID mukaj/fin-mpnet-base (no license field, best FiQA 79.91 but unshippable).
INCLUDED (owner-confirmed). SciDocs 81.9; already deployable via TEI. specter2_base (apache-2.0) is the fallback if SciNCL bring-up slips.
